name: revela_isp_core
description: The board's display pipeline: pedestal off, illuminant balanced, Hamilton-Adams demosaic in its two streaming stages, colour matrix, display curve, and the mark. Geometry and CFA phase ride the bayerlink header, so this design carries them as stream context -- ports latched at each frame's start, never registers.

inputs.name: isp_in
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from the bayerlink receiver, samples already aligned to this build's depth.

outputs.name: isp_out
outputs.description: Tone-mapped RGB, three 10-bit channels in one word: R low, G mid, B high.

nodes.description: Remove the sensor pedestal per CFA colour, before anything multiplies the signal.
Per-CFA-colour gain, the AWB loop's actuator. Before demosaic: interpolating unbalanced planes bakes the imbalance into all three channels.
Hamilton-Adams green reconstruction, direction-adaptive; emits the (raw, green) word the chroma stage differences against.
Red and blue as colour differences against the reconstructed green.
Sensor RGB into the target colour space; a calibration output, written over the register map.
Display tone curve per channel, one shared knot table. knots bits = bit_depth + 1.
The mark, from block RAM, keyed over the corner of the picture.
